# The Pages allowlist: what .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes, and what it deliberately does not.
#
# Sam on #3104 (relayed by COBIx, 2026-11-11 3:34 AM PT): "yes to all recommendations". The first of them:
# publish only from an allowlist, so a new file or folder stays off the public site until someone decides.
#
# Three kinds of line:
#   publish <path>      A tracked file or folder, literal. "Assemble lean site" exports exactly these paths
#                       from the commit (git archive) and fails, naming it, if one is not in the commit.
#                       A folder publishes everything under it, including what is added later.
#   publish? <path>     The same, for a path a workflow will create (a generator output a code-only PR
#                       introduces): published once it is in the commit, skipped with a notice until then.
#                       A publish? line stays publish? after its path is tracked, by design: the workflow
#                       may delete and recreate it, and the deploy must not stop in between.
#   withhold <pattern>  Never published. A literal path or a shell pattern (* within one path segment, never
#                       a leading dot), matched from the top as the old prune matched it. Withhold lines only
#                       record a decision; the deploy reads publish lines alone, so a withhold line can never
#                       put anything on the site. A publish line wins over a withhold pattern: that is how
#                       kb/csr_out/latest.json is served from inside the withheld kb/*_out. A pattern carries a
#                       fixed stem or folder: "*.js", "*.html", "*.json" alone would hide every future page.
#
# Every tracked file, and every path a workflow stages with git add, must be under a publish line or
# matched by a withhold line, or tests/pages_allowlist.test.js fails: give a new path a line in the same
# change that adds it (publish? when the workflow, not the PR, will commit it).
# Where a folder is split (the root, kb/, kb/reference/ ...), each published entry has its own line.
#
# Day one (S649) publishes exactly the 22,705 files the old prune published (proven three times in #3278).
# Why each withheld path stays internal: docs/pages_lean_deploy_scope.md and the history of pages.yml.
# Keep the publish block sorted.

# ── withhold ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Repo machinery, never browser-fetched.
withhold .github
withhold archive
withhold chatbox
withhold docs
withhold funding
withhold news
withhold nudges
withhold reflections
withhold scripts
withhold tests
withhold tmc/source_data
withhold tools
# Root workbooks.
withhold *.xlsx
# kb/ staging, curated anchors and lexicons: generator inputs baked into the served unified_courses_*.js.
withhold kb/cid_articulation_joins.json
withhold kb/coci_minted_courses.json
withhold kb/coci_minted_memberships.json
withhold kb/coci_minted_singletons.json
withhold kb/coci_unified_courses.json
withhold kb/common_courses.json
withhold kb/course_crosswalk.json
withhold kb/discipline_inference.json
withhold kb/promotions.json
# Re-mint, fold, dry-run and apply output (alias maps, collisions). kb/csr_out/latest.json and
# kb/cer_procedures_out/latest.json are published by their own lines below.
withhold kb/*_apply
withhold kb/*_dryrun
withhold kb/*_fold
withhold kb/*_out
withhold kb/subj4_*
# Audit provenance: only the slim latest.json summaries are served.
withhold kb/exhibit_audit/*.md
withhold kb/row_audit/*.md
# Data-write receipts (Rule 10 a2): 2.0 GB of the 2.9 GB site on 2026-11-10 (COBIx on #3077).
withhold kb/receipts
# The CareerOneStop registry (tracker-internal under its terms), the MOC crosswalk registry, workbooks.
withhold kb/reference/*.xlsx
withhold kb/reference/cos_certifications.json
withhold kb/reference/moc_crosswalk.json
# The bulk COCI program and program-course dumps program-course-fetch.yml commits; no page reads them.
withhold kb/reference/coci_program_*.csv
# The harvest's scout files and heading-agreement snapshot (S645, review of #3201).
withhold kb/harvest_scouting
withhold kb/status/harvest_heading_agreement.json
withhold kb/status/harvest_heading_agreement.md
# Standing pattern for a dated file automation adds (the course-outcomes compare); no page reads one, and the
# ones already committed stay published by their own lines.
withhold kb/status/mid_outcomes_compare_*

# Internal paths no page reads (#3104 follow-up; COBIx on #3278; review findings 8 and 10). Each was searched
# for in every published .html/.js/.css (fetches, hrefs, script src, built-up paths): no reader found.
# Edge Functions that read files from raw GitHub are unaffected by Pages.
# Staff contact harvest: named college officials with email and phone (a new run folder per harvest).
withhold kb/contacts_harvest
withhold kb/contacts_harvest_seeds.json
# Agent and scanner configuration, and a recording transcript.
withhold .claude
withhold .gitleaks.toml
withhold .gitleaksignore
withhold .video-context
withhold CLAUDE.md
# Database migrations, table SQL, the MAP sync scripts and SQL, memory seeds, and audit output.
withhold kb/college_identity
withhold kb/cpl_memory_*seed*.json
withhold kb/docs_audit
withhold kb/memory_audit
withhold kb/migrations
withhold kb/supabase_*.sql
withhold map
# Python scripts: build and sync tooling, never fetched by a page.
withhold *.py
withhold documents/*.py
withhold fact-sheet/*.py
withhold kb/*.py
withhold partners/ctdl-exchange/seed/tools/*.py
withhold presentations/*.py
withhold presentations/cac_2026-08/*.py
withhold prototype/*.py
withhold prototype/funding_video/*.py
withhold prototype/globe/*.py
withhold prototype/ironworker_video/*.py
withhold prototype/mockup_harness/*.py
withhold prototype/noncredit_video/*.py
withhold raci/*.py
withhold statewide
withhold tmc/*.py
withhold veteran-sprint-map/*.py
